notes.title: V5.17.4 Optimizations & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1. Improved path recognition in quick switch tool, added %localappdata% support;
2. Fixed poor tooltip display in multilingual mode.

notes.title: V5.17.2 Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1. Removed all DLL dependencies except for Steam.
2. Fixed crash issue when base64 conversion results contain newline characters.

notes.title: V5.16.0 Workshop Update - Support for Any File Upload
notes.notes: Now you can upload any file through the Workshop entrance on the main interface, in addition to uploading your own images in puzzle games, making it easier for everyone to share their files.

notes.title: V5.8.1 Error Version Correction
notes.notes:
I sincerely apologize.
Due to my negligence,
an incorrect version was uploaded,
causing inconvenience to our dear users and disrupting the normal use of this feature.
Astonishingly, it took me two weeks to discover this fatal error.
I don't know how to express my apologies or compensate for the losses.
If anyone has any suggestions, please feel free to leave me a message.

Once again, thanks to user [Yasuo-main from League of Legend] for bringing this critical issue to my attention.


Additionally, I want to add that I have always had a disaster recovery branch,
which involves switching the branch to 'lastversion'.
This is the last stable version I defined to prevent such issues.
However, I have never made it public.
I take this opportunity to mention it.

notes.title: V5.7.4 Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Fix the issue where the app crashes in certain scenarios when using the quick replace function to replace files.

notes.title: V5.7.3 Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue where some programs might encounter errors due to local path problems when opening other programs;
2. Fixed an issue in quick replacement where replacing files with \\ in local network paths was not supported.

notes.title: V5.3.1 Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Fix issue where maximize button is displayed incorrectly when window is closed while maximized.

notes.title: V5.3.0 Feature Update
notes.notes:
According to user needs, add the boss key function,

Add the shortcut key of the BOSS COME, which can hide the current focus window;
Add the shortcut key of the BOSS LEAVE, which can restore hidden windows in turn;

Can be set in the setting shortcut key

Because the time is relatively tight, the interface I thought of has not been done yet.
At the same time, I also plan to make a pure help window to advance the use of so many functions,
Hope to be free soon

notes.title: V2.5.0 Feature Update
notes.notes:
Right-click menu:
Add:
1. Replace file/folder
2. Copy and replace file/folder
Delete:
1. Switch to the target file;
2. Switch to the target folder;

The company's projects are updated with new branch every two weeks,
In this way, the daily build directory will change every time,
Previously, switching the shortcut destination folder required selecting a directory,
But the build directory is a network directory and cannot be selected,
cause I have to do it again,
So this time I re-wrote the function of switching targets function

A new window will appear when switching targets,
Just drag and drop the files/folders to be updated,
easy and convenient,
Improve work efficiency
